title: Birational morphisms induce morphisms of normalizations over a dense open

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the statement

standard_prerequisites.name: Normalization over a dense open
standard_prerequisites.use: The finite covers over dense opens.

core_obligations: Reduce to the finite covers over the dense opens.
On a common dense open the birational morphism is an isomorphism of generic points; apply the scheme case on the covers.
The induced morphism of normalizations descends over the dense open.
proof_roadmap: Reduction to finite covers; scheme case; descent of the induced morphism.
difficulty_reason: A reduction chain into the scheme case; the descent step is the substance.
